name: rtk-agnt-integration
description: AGNT integration for RTK (Rust Token Killer). Runs shell commands through RTK to save 60-90% tokens on outputs like git status, cargo test, docker ps, and more.
author: AGNT Community

schema.title: RTK Runner
schema.description: Executes shell commands through RTK (Rust Token Killer) to return token-optimized output.

command.description: The shell command to run through RTK (e.g. 'git status', 'cargo test', 'docker ps', 'ls -la')

workingDirectory.description: Optional working directory to execute the command in

ultraCompact.description: Use RTK ultra-compact mode (-u) for maximum token savings

rawFallback.description: If RTK is not installed, fallback to raw command output
